name: Morning Greeting (朝礼)
description: Learn the polite morning greeting ritual used at the start of a factory shift
grammar_focus: おはようございます (formal morning greeting)
～からよろしくお願いします (from today onwards, please be kind to me)
cultural_notes: Morning greetings are essential workplace etiquette
Using polite language shows respect and professionalism

nodes.speaker: supervisor
nodes.text: おはようございます。今日からよろしくお願いします。
nodes.english: Good morning. Let's work well together from today.

nodes.speaker: worker
nodes.expected_response: おはようございます。よろしくお願いします。
nodes.english: Good morning. I look forward to working with you.

nodes.speaker: supervisor
nodes.text: では、今日の作業を説明します。
nodes.english: Then, let me explain today's work.
